Faction Profile: faction-profile-v1 soulspire-solutions soulspire-solutions Faction_System_Packet/factions/Corps_Touching_The_Oneshot.md strong True True soulspire Soulspire Solutions Comforting soul insurance and afterlife services sold as peace of mind. Soulspire™: rest easy, we'll handle the rest. Soulspire Solutions™ sells peace of mind now and, once the debt outlives you, repossesses the soul that had it. Everything about Soulspire™ is soothing on purpose: lavender light, a hushed lobby, a counselor in soft grey who calls death a 'transition event' and your grief a 'coverage gap.' Brochures for the Eternal Comfort Plan™ show smiling families and a tasteful urn; the waiting-room hymn loops a wellness ballad about rest. Sign the Afterlife Assurance™ and you will feel genuinely better, which is the point, because page forty-seven of the same friendly packet is where a person legally stops being one and becomes, in their cheerful internal term, a 'continuing contributor.' The undead on the night roads are not monsters. They are accounts in good standing. A Soulspire pamphlet folds open like a condolence card. The ink is blue-black, the border is tasteful, and the little painted candle at the top...
